info.name: Issues API
info.description:
Full Postman collection for the Issues feature.

Base URL variable: {{baseUrl}} (e.g. http://localhost:8000)
Auth token variable: {{token}}

Collection variables:
  - baseUrl      → http://localhost:8000
  - token        → Your JWT token
  - companyId    → Target company ID
  - projectId    → Target project ID
  - issueId      → Target issue ID
  - statusId     → Target status ID
  - sprintId     → Target sprint ID
  - userId       → Target user ID (for watchers)
  - itemId       → Checklist item ID

Base path: /api/v1/tasks-management/issues

Folders:
  1. CRUD           — Create, Get, Update, Delete, Archive, Restore, Duplicate
  2. Move & Reorder — Move Status, Move Sprint, Reorder
  3. Watchers       — Get, Add, Remove
  4. Checklist      — Add, Update, Delete

request.description:
Creates a new issue.

Required fields:
  - companyId  (string)
  - projectId  (MongoDB ObjectId)
  - title      (1–300 chars)

Optional fields:
  - description
  - type        → task | bug | story | epic | feature | improvement | subTask  (default: task)
  - priority    → lowest | low | medium | high | highest | critical              (default: medium)
  - visibility  → public | private | team                                        (default: team)
  - statusId    — must belong to the same project
  - sprintId    — must belong to the same project
  - milestoneId
  - parentId    — must belong to the same project
  - assignedTo  — array of user ID strings; all must be project members
  - tags        — array of strings
  - links       — array of { title, url }
  - storyPoints
  - progress    (0–100)
  - order
  - startDate, dueDate  (ISO 8601)
  - timeTracking.estimate  (minutes)

Validations:
  ✔ Project must exist and not be deleted
  ✔ Status must belong to the project
  ✔ Sprint must belong to the project
  ✔ Parent issue must be in the same project
  ✔ All assignees must be project members

Activity logged: create

lowest | low | medium | high | highest | critical
Case-insensitive search in title and description
createdAt | updatedAt | dueDate | startDate | priority | order | title | type | progress | storyPoints

request.description:
Returns a paginated, filtered, sortable list of issues.

All filter params are optional. Defaults:
  - archived = false  (archived issues excluded)
  - deleted  = false  (deleted issues excluded)
  - sortBy   = createdAt
  - sortOrder = desc
  - page = 1, limit = 20

Use archived=only or deleted=only to list only those records.
Use archived=true or deleted=true to include them alongside normal records.

The `tags` param accepts a comma-separated list and matches issues that have ANY of those tags.

Returns a single issue by its MongoDB ObjectId.

Returns 404 if the issue does not exist or is soft-deleted.

Updates one or more fields of an issue.

All fields are optional — send only what you want to change.

Updatable fields:
  title, description, type, priority, visibility,
  statusId, sprintId, milestoneId, parentId,
  assignedTo, tags, links,
  dependencies, blockedBy, nextTaskIds,
  timeTracking { estimate, logged, remaining },
  storyPoints, progress, order,
  startDate, dueDate

Automatically logs targeted activity events when:
  - statusId  changes  → change_status activity
  - priority  changes  → change_priority activity
  - sprintId  changes  → change_sprint activity
  - assignedTo changes → assign / unassign activities
Plus a generic 'update' activity is always logged.

lastActivityAt is updated automatically.

Soft-deletes an issue.

Sets deletedAt = now. Issue is excluded from all list queries by default.
Data is preserved in MongoDB.
Can be restored via the Restore endpoint.

Activity logged: delete

Archives an issue.

Sets archivedAt = now. The issue is excluded from default list queries.
Returns 400 if the issue is already archived.

Note: archive and delete are independent states (separate fields).

Activity logged: archive

Restores a soft-deleted or archived issue.

Clears both deletedAt and archivedAt.
Returns 400 if the issue is neither deleted nor archived.

Activity logged: restore

Creates a deep clone of an existing issue.

The clone:
  - Appends " (Copy)" to the title
  - Resets all date fields (startDate, dueDate, completedAt) to null
  - Resets progress to 0
  - Resets order to source.order + 1
  - Copies checklist items (all reset to uncompleted)
  - Sets createdBy to the authenticated user

Returns the new cloned issue.

Activity logged: duplicate

Moves an issue to a different status column (Kanban/Scrum board drag-and-drop).

Required:
  - statusId  (ObjectId) — must belong to the same project as the issue

Validation:
  ✔ Status must belong to the issue's project

Activity logged: change_status

Moves an issue to a different sprint.

Required:
  - sprintId (ObjectId) — must belong to the same project.
    Send null to move the issue to the backlog.

Validation:
  ✔ Sprint must belong to the issue's project

Activity logged: change_sprint

Bulk-updates the `order` field for multiple issues in a single request.

Use this after a drag-and-drop reorder inside a status column or backlog.

Required:
  - items  (array, min 1 element)
    - id    (ObjectId) — the issue to update
    - order (integer ≥ 0) — the new position index

Uses MongoDB bulkWrite for efficiency.
Returns { reordered: N } where N is the number of issues updated.

Returns all watchers for a given issue.

Watchers are stored in the separate `task_watchers` collection (not embedded in the Issue document).
Each record contains: issueId, userId, createdAt.

Adds a watcher to an issue.

Optional body:
  - userId  — the user to add as a watcher.
              Defaults to the authenticated user if omitted.

No-op (upsert) if the user is already watching the issue.

Activity logged: add_watcher

Removes a specific user from the issue's watcher list.

Path params:
  - issueId  — the issue
  - userId   — the watcher to remove

Activity logged: remove_watcher

Adds a checklist item to an issue.

Checklist items are embedded directly in the Issue document (atomic save).

Required:
  - title  (1–500 chars)

Optional:
  - order  (integer ≥ 0) — defaults to current checklist length (appended)

Activity logged: add_checklist

Updates a checklist item embedded in an issue.

Path params:
  - issueId — the parent issue
  - itemId  — the checklist item ObjectId

All body fields are optional:
  - title      (1–500 chars)
  - completed  (boolean) — when set to true, completedBy is automatically set to the auth user
  - order      (integer ≥ 0)

Activity logged: update_checklist

Deletes a checklist item from an issue.

Path params:
  - issueId — the parent issue
  - itemId  — the checklist item ObjectId

Returns 404 if the item is not found.

Activity logged: delete_checklist
